name: HETTA + MANGUALDE + TAPE
description: This is a concert featuring HETTA, MANGUALDE, and TAPE at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is scheduled for October 31, 2026, starting at 10 PM.
longDescription:
The event HETTA + MANGUALDE + TAPE is a concert taking place at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. It is scheduled for Saturday, October 31, 2026, with a start time of 22:00 and a duration of 120 minutes.

The concert features performances by HETTA and MANGUALDE, with photography credits to Francisco Fidalgo for HETTA and Matheus Oliveira for MANGUALDE. The age classification for this event is 16 years and older.

Tickets are priced at 10€ for general admission if purchased in advance. Tickets bought at the door will cost 12€. The venue is located at RUA JOÃO MARTINS BRANCO 180, 4150-430 Porto.
